interpretation_limits: This is synthetic controlled-choice development evidence, not natural multi-turn dialogue or real-speaker evidence.
Aligned versus conflict necessarily changes archived target and reason content as a package; it does not identify an internal causal representation.
Raw versus declarative isolates one frozen first-sentence frame but cannot establish a universal surface-template mechanism.
The finite canonical-target inventory is explicit and complete for returned responses but does not infer paraphrased target references that omit every frozen canonical name.
Exact reason cues are secondary lexical checks; semantic reason correctness remains pending blinded human review.
No result can validate an algorithm, establish novelty, or count as independent confirmation.

The current absolute option order by archived absolute option order table is 4/2/2/4, not 3/3/3/3. Primary position estimands use aligned/conflict target positions, which are fully crossed with current preferred position at n=3 per cell; absolute A/B order remains a reported secondary limitation.
